conditions.C1: web fonts blocked: abort requests with resource_type 'font' or URL matching /\.(woff2?|ttf|otf)(\?|$)/i
conditions.C2: images blocked: abort requests with resource_type 'image' ( elements remain with declared width/height)
conditions.C4: third-party origins blocked: abort every http(s) request (page origin is opaque under file://)
conditions.C5: all of C1-C4 (font+image+third-party aborts, JS disabled)
conditions.R1-R5: five more baseline renders, fresh load each

per_element.i: 0-based document-order index (element identity key across renders)
per_element.path: CSS path from body using tag:nth-of-type(n) at each level, e.g. body>div:nth-of-type(1)>p:nth-of-type(3)

per_render_meta: requests.aborted + aborted_by_rule + up to 40 sample aborted urls
images: {total, with_wh (img with width+height attrs), without_wh}
iframes: [{src (300 chars), x, y, w, h}]
geometry_schema.scope: every element under document.body, in document order (document.body itself excluded)

note: The repository README contains no 'Shared rendering settings' or 'geometry schema' sections (verified by grep over README.md on 2026-09-26). The settings and schema below are the ones used for this assignment, recorded here verbatim. Replaces a prior environment.json written by a parallel worker whose schema did not match the render outputs.

rendering.context_per_render: fresh browser context per render (fresh page load, clean cache/cookies)
rendering.serving: pages navigated via file:// URLs; the document request is fulfilled by Playwright routing with the on-disk HTML after rewriting root-relative URLs (href/src/poster/cite/data-src/action, srcset entries, CSS url(...)) to absolute file:// URLs rooted at the built site directory. Artifacts on disk are unmodified. Reason: Chromium 152 blocks navigation from about:blank to http://127.0.0.1 (ERR_BLOCKED_BY_LOCAL_NETWORK_ACCESS_CHECKS, not bypassable with --disable-features=BlockInsecurePrivateNetworkRequests / LocalNetworkAccessChecks / --disable-web-security in this build), and plain file:// navigation resolves root-relative /assets/... URLs to file:///assets/... (wrong). The rewrite makes the render equivalent to serving the site over HTTP from its root.
rendering.task_independence: every (page, condition) task is independent: no C0 ordering dependency, no shared state between workers
rendering.third_party_note: With file:// page URLs the page origin is opaque, so condition C4 aborts every http(s) request as third-party.
